title: Karyawan departemen IT
prompt:
Tabel `employees(id, name, dept, salary)`.

Tampilkan kolom `name` semua karyawan di departemen `'IT'`, diurutkan berdasarkan nama (A→Z).

data.schema: CREATE TABLE employees (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, dept TEXT NOT NULL, salary INTEGER NOT NULL);
data.seed: INSERT INTO employees (name, dept, salary) VALUES ('Sari', 'IT', 12000000), ('Budi', 'HR', 8000000), ('Andi', 'IT', 15000000), ('Dewi', 'Finance', 11000000), ('Rina', 'IT', 9000000);

referenceSolution: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE dept = 'IT' ORDER BY name;
explanation: `WHERE` memfilter baris, `ORDER BY` mengurutkan hasil (default ASC). String di SQL memakai tanda kutip tunggal.
